claim_or_scope: W is the complete frozen official source file (Council Directive 86/361/EEC, original act); all 93 units (12 formal units, 14 recitals, 12 articles with 67 units) were inventoried and screened in source order.
search_description: Every unit read in source order and screened (UNIT_SCREENING); internal cross-references (Article N, paragraph N, point) identified by reading and followed within W; all references to instruments or bodies outside W identified by reading (EXTERNAL_REFERENCES). No external retrieval. "Not found" statements concern the search of this corpus only.

claim_or_scope: Search for references to sources outside W in all units, including recitals, citations and footnotes.
search_description: All units read; ten EXT records created (recital-only references are not coded, RGAM-DR-07); the four with constitutive dependency are listed in INSTRUMENT_LEVEL_SUMMARY; references identified only in recitals (e.g., the Commission communication, Council recommendations, Standards Code of GATT, CEN-CENELEC guidelines, the Copenhagen agreement) create no record.

claim_or_scope: Necessity of the Committee opinion stage before the Commission decision on withdrawing a specification (ground (b) route, A8.P4).
search_description: Article 8 and cross-referenced provisions read; A8.P4 states that the Commission decides "on the basis of that opinion"; the electrical-safety branch (A8.P2) is governed by an external procedure that may displace or overlay the route; Directive 83/189/EEC applies without prejudice.

claim_or_scope: Substitutability of the Commission request to the CEPT as the route by which common conformity specifications come into being ("no alternative path").
search_description: Articles 2(13), 2(15), 4(2), 6(1) read; A6.P1 states that a NET shall be regarded as the equivalent of the common conformity specification, which does not exclude other forms; NET adoption rests on an external Memorandum of Understanding; non-prejudice clause for Directive 83/189/EEC.

claim_or_scope: No ANSWERABILITY or ACCOUNTABILITY relation is coded in SC-04 (waiver procedure), other than INFO relations.
search_description: All relations of SC-04 examined for duty to explain/justify, questioning capacity, assessment capacity and consequence; the Committee review (NA) has no stated consequence; the Commission agreement on extension is an authorization, not an assessment of the Member State's explanation.

claim_or_scope: No qualified coupling between SC-04 (waiver procedure) and SC-05 (suspension/safeguard procedure) other than shared participants (Commission, Committee, CEPT, Member States).
search_description: Articles 7(4) and 8 read for cross-references between them; none found other than both leading to Commission/CEPT/Committee steps; "not found" concerns the search, and absence of an edge does not establish separation.
